Findings and parent reconciliation before implementation:
1. Unicode/space cases alone do not prove NUL-delimited parsing. RESOLVED IN PLAN:
   add synthetic embedded-newline/tab output case portable on Windows.
2. Missing-dependency checks must cover all top-level path maps, especially
   curriculum/listeningTasks/listeningTaskAudio/listeningTaskImages JsonElement maps.
   RESOLVED IN PLAN: enumerate every object-valued top-level section as the
   existing content budget checker does; regression iterates all nine current maps.
3. Include unmanifested nonignored runtime addition. RESOLVED IN PLAN:
   positive fixture asserts actual untracked extra bytes are loaded.
4. Preserve separate stderr diagnostics and fail on nonzero Git exit before
   reading selected files. RESOLVED IN PLAN: inherit stderr, consume stdout,
   check completion before reading manifest/corpus; no fallback or skip.
5. Read only manifest before coverage validation. ACCEPTED implementation invariant.
Optional bounded Git timeout: DEFERRED; local ls-files with inherited stderr
and drained stdout is the existing mechanism, no need to add process policy here.

No evidence deletion, production change, assertion removal or memory-limit change.
Proceed with isolated implementation and focused regressions, then fresh3+1 gate
and independent diff review. A passing fixture is not native/phone acceptance.
